description: Erection of a single storey front infill extension and single storey rear extension, and installation of solar panels and a rear roof light to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (177 / PL03 (Rev B); 177 / PL05 (Rev B)  Received:  01 November 2022;  177 / PL02 (Rev B); 177 / PL 10  Received:  13 September 2022;  177 / PL 01 (Rev A); 177 / PL04 (Rev A); 177 / PL06 (Rev A)  Received:  16 August 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey front infill extension and single storey rear extension hereby approved.
